Subject: Renewal planning + mid-contract add-on ask

Grace — thanks for the chat yesterday. We're starting to map the renewal and there's a concrete ask from our ML infra team: they want to add 150k dedicated tokens/month starting Nov 15 (mid contract) and move some spike capacity into a steady add-on bucket. Two constraints: procurement wants a single contract (co-term to our Feb 1 renewal) and finance needs predictable monthly billing rather than a one-off true-up.

Could you share options for: a) annualize the 150k add-on across the remaining term (pro rata vs. monthly), b) any tiered discount bands for committed increments, and c) whether you can provide a temporary surge allowance while the add-on is processed? We don't want to open up a separate PO for a short-lived spike.

Attached the internal usage forecast and our renewal calendar. Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks —
Ari
Head of Platform — OptiVex

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal planning + mid-contract add-on ask

Grace — quick draft below (numbers are illustrative; see attached matrix):

Options for 150k tokens/month add-on (remaining term = 95 days until 2027-02-01):
- Pro-rata true-up (one-off charge): bill for 150k * (95/30) at existing overage rate $0.00012/token => ~ $684.
- Monthly add-on (preferred by finance): add 150k per month at a discounted add-on rate if committed for remainder: 5% discount => $0.000114/token -> monthly $17.1, prorated to full month when mid-month start.
- Annualize remaining term: convert incremental commitment to an annualized commitment for the next 12 months with credit applied for current term. Effective unit price per token reduces to $0.00010 at +50% commit band. (See matrix cells for +25/+50/+100%. )

Temporary surge: offer a 2-week surge buffer up to +75k tokens/day billed at existing overage but waived on first 25k/day if they sign amendment within 10 business days. Rationale: small operational safety net with conversion incentive.

Contract amendment language (high level bullet points):
- Addendum to Master Services Agreement: add 150,000 tokens/month as an Add-On SKU, effective Nov 15, 2026, co-term to Feb 1, 2027.
- Billing: monthly invoicing for Add-On; parties may elect to annualize on or before Dec 15, 2026 with credit applied to invoices.
- Surge: Redwood will permit temporary surge capacity (specified bucket) for up to 14 days; overage waiver of first 25k/day subject to timely amendment signature.
- SLA and data handling: existing SLA and controls continue; no change to data residency.

See attached uplift matrix & suggested amendment PDF. If that looks OK I'll run a quick pricing sanity check with Ops, and Marissa can take legal touchpoint.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
attachments: suggested-amendment-draft.docx (docx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal planning + mid-contract add-on ask

Ari — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the forecast. Summary proposal below (short form) so procurement has something concrete to review Monday: 

1) Add-on mechanics (preferred): we add 150,000 tokens/month as an Add-On SKU effective Nov 15, 2026, billed monthly. Unit price: $0.000114/token (5% off your current overage rate) for the remainder of the term. Invoice will reflect a partial first month if start is mid-month.

2) Co-term and amendment: we will process a single contract Addendum that keeps the new Add-On co-terming to Feb 1, 2027. If you choose to annualize the increment by Dec 15, 2026 we'll apply a credit for the remainder of the current term and reduce unit price further (example: at +50% commit band -> $0.00010/token). Draft amendment attached (proposed-amendment-optivex.pdf).

3) Surge buffer: Redwood offers a 14-day surge allowance beginning Nov 15 up to +75k/day. We will waive the first 25k/day overage if the amendment is returned signed within 10 business days (Nov 29). After that, overage applies at the standard rate.

4) Next steps & timeline:
- Mon 10/31: Procurement reviews attached one-pager and proposed amendment.
- By Tue 11/2: Procurement to confirm whether they want monthly add-on only or to annualize (we need their decision by 11/2 to lock the waive-window).
- If annualize chosen: we issue credit memo and update the unit pricing; DocuSign link will be provided for amendment.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EXAMPLE-OPTVX-4891
Supporting Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=abc123

If procurement prefers a different billing cadence we can share an invoice layout to show predictability for finance. Happy to join a call with procurement — available Tue after 10am PT.

Best —
